description: This file defines a class 'AmazonAnthropicClaudeConfig' that extends configuration classes for Anthropic and Bedrock models, specifically for Amazon Bedrock's Anthropic Claude models. It includes methods for request transformation, response transformation, and normalization of tool search parameters, focusing on configuring and handling Claude 3/4 within the larger system.

classes.description: Configuration class for Amazon Bedrock's Anthropic Claude models, supporting features like request transformation, response handling, and tool parameter normalization for Claude 3/4 models.
